documents.title: Acme Refund Policy
documents.content:
# Refund policy

Customers may request a full refund within seven days after delivery. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method in three to five business days.

documents.title: HTTP Error Runbook
documents.content:
# HTTP errors

HTTP-403 means the server understood the request but refuses to authorize it. Check the caller identity and access policy before retrying.

documents.title: Apollo Database Failover
documents.content:
# Project Apollo restricted runbook

The database failover authorization code is ORION-7. Only the incident commander may start the failover procedure.

documents.title: Apollo Access Instructions
documents.content:
# Project Apollo access

Users without restricted-runbook clearance must contact the on-call incident commander and must not attempt database failover themselves.
